name: Enzyme Substrate Genetic Context
plain_language_rule: Predict treatment when The candidate drug independently affects the same disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. All more-specific descendants are explicitly excluded, leaving only biolink:affects.; The disease-associated enzyme has the candidate drug as a substrate The pinned descendant closure is biolink:has_substrate. At least one primary source must be infores:chembl.; The enzyme is genetically associated with the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:gene_associated_with_condition. At least one primary source must be infores:geneticskp.
hypothesis: A disease-linked enzyme substrate may provide metabolic intervention or replacement context.

edges.subject: chemical
edges.explanation: The candidate drug independently affects the same disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. All more-specific descendants are explicitly excluded, leaving only biolink:affects.
edges.exclusion_rationale: This arm tests the exact stated relation; response, adverse, treatment, and other more-specific assertions would change its biological meaning.

edges.subject: gene
edges.explanation: The disease-associated enzyme has the candidate drug as a substrate The pinned descendant closure is biolink:has_substrate. At least one primary source must be infores:chembl.

edges.subject: gene
edges.explanation: The enzyme is genetically associated with the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:gene_associated_with_condition. At least one primary source must be infores:geneticskp.

mechanism.rationale: A disease-linked enzyme substrate may provide metabolic intervention or replacement context. The graph pattern is a hypothesis, not proof of clinical efficacy.

execution.cypher_template: MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:{{relationship_types:direct}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE direct.predicate IN {{predicates:direct}} MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[substrate:{{relationship_types:substrate}}]->(chemical:Drug) WHERE substrate.predicate IN {{predicates:substrate}} AND any(source IN ["infores:chembl"] WHERE source IN coalesce(substrate.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[association:{{relationship_types:association}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE association.predicate IN {{predicates:association}} AND any(source IN ["infores:geneticskp"] WHERE source IN coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count

trapi.limitations: Outside TRAPI: direct: discard exact predicates biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates; substrate: enforce primary-source membership in infores:chembl; association: enforce primary-source membership in infores:geneticskp

limitations: Unknown predictions are unlabeled, not known negatives.
Canonical graph identifiers are deduplicated; parallel evidence does not multiply gene support.
Metabolic processing can affect drug exposure without treating the enzyme-linked disease; this is an association diagnostic.
